parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the traffic mirror session is enabled. Valid values:

- **false** (default): The traffic mirror session is not enabled.

- **true**: The traffic mirror session is enabled.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return in this query. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
- You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
- If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
The priority of traffic mirror session. Valid values: **1** to **32766**.

A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The priority of traffic mirror session created by the same account in the same region must be unique.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the traffic mirror session. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID. For information about the regions that support traffic mirroring, see [Traffic mirroring overview](~~207513~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the traffic mirroring session belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: TrafficMirrorFilterId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the traffic mirror filter.

parameters.name: TrafficMirrorSessionIds
parameters.description: The instance IDs of traffic mirror sessions. The maximum value of **N** is **100**, which means you can query up to 100 traffic mirror sessions.

parameters.name: TrafficMirrorSessionName
parameters.description:
The name of the traffic mirror session.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: TrafficMirrorSourceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the traffic mirror source. Currently, elastic network interfaces (ENIs) are supported as traffic mirror sources.

parameters.name: TrafficMirrorTargetId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the traffic mirror destination. Currently, elastic network interfaces (ENIs) and internal-facing SLB instances are supported as traffic mirror destinations. Elastic network interfaces are also referred to as network interface controllers (NICs).

parameters.name: VirtualNetworkId
parameters.description: The Virtual Network Identifier (VNI) used to distinguish different mirrored data. Valid values: **0** to **16777215**. You can use the VNI to identify mirrored data from different sessions at the traffic mirror destination. You can specify a custom VNI value or let the system randomly assign one. To let the system randomly assign a value, do not specify this parameter.
